rationale: Replaced live truncation with a validated finite JSON payload, exclusive same-directory temporary, write-all loop, file fsync, descriptor-relative atomic replace and parent fsync. Identity checks and cleanup only of the created temporary avoid rewriting unrelated targets. Faults before/after replace report observed replacement state instead of fabricated success; per-session completed files and original causes remain explicit. Original partial-write reproduction lost the prior JSON; final fixtures preserve old or new valid content by commit boundary, including controlled abrupt child exit. This closes per-file truncation/durability mechanics, not a transaction across the three files.
